title.en: Streamflow guidance playback on a river network

records.summary: Play modelled streamflow over a river network while keeping guidance, observation and visualisation clearly separated.
records.objective: Build a river network where forecast streamflow values animate over time with their provenance, horizon and guidance status stated on screen.
intent_signals: Play back modelled streamflow along a river network.
Show forecast guidance without presenting it as observed data.
example_prompts: Build a river network playback of streamflow values with a time cursor and a provenance panel.
Compare a forecast horizon with observations at a gauge location.
negative_signals: Not a hydrological model: nothing is computed here, and the scene must not imply prediction.
Not an operational warning tool; official forecasts and warnings come from the responsible agency.
not_for: Not a hydrological model: nothing is computed here, and the scene must not imply prediction.
Not an operational warning tool; official forecasts and warnings come from the responsible agency.

entities.name: River network
entities.guidance: Build the network as connected reaches with identifiers, since every value in the dataset belongs to a reach.

entities.name: Time series playback
entities.guidance: Bind values to a time axis with the forecast issue time and horizon shown, so a frame is always attributable.

entities.name: Provenance panel
entities.guidance: State the source model, its version, the horizon, the units and whether values are guidance or observations.

state_contract.model: Reach geometry with identifiers, per-reach time series from a supplied dataset with issue time, lead time and valid time distinguished, an explicit mapping from observation stations to reach identifiers, a playback index over valid time, and a provenance record. Missing values are shown as gaps rather than interpolated across by default. Observations and model guidance are separate series.
state_contract.authority: The supplied dataset is authoritative and read-only; the scene may interpolate for display but must mark interpolated frames as such.
actions: Scrub or play the time index.
Select a reach and inspect its series.
Reset playback and reload the dataset.

invariants: Every displayed value names its reach, its units, and which time it refers to: issue time, lead time or valid time. Comparisons between series are aligned on valid time.
Guidance and observation series are never merged into a single unlabelled curve.
Playback beyond the dataset horizon stops and says so instead of extrapolating.
motion_guidance: Play frames at a stated real-time to model-time ratio with the model clock visible.
Animate reach width or colour from the value with a legend; do not animate flow particles at speeds that imply a computed velocity.
known_limits: No dataset is bundled: the user supplies data, its licence and its provenance.

Modelled guidance can differ substantially from observations. The scene may display a numerical difference between aligned series; what it cannot do is establish forecast skill, which needs a verification study rather than a viewer.
Authored guidance only: no scene runtime, rendering or numerical calibration has been run for this recipe.

claims.statement: A continental-scale water model simulates and forecasts streamflow for millions of river reaches with short, medium and long range forecast horizons, and its output is described as guidance that complements official river forecasts at a much smaller number of locations.
claims.scope: Coverage and guidance status as described on the cited page; no forecast values were retrieved or republished here.

source_refs.locator: About the National Water Model, coverage and forecast horizons

object_craft.structure: Reaches as tubes following channel centrelines with junctions modelled as real confluences.
object_craft.material: Neutral channel material with the value encoded by a legended colour ramp and by a width glyph. That width is a data glyph, not wetted river width or flood extent; the reach centreline and topology stay fixed while the glyph varies.
object_craft.articulation: Reach geometry is static; only value-driven appearance and the time cursor change.

object_craft.structure: A panel in the scene listing model, version, issue time, horizon, units and licence.
object_craft.material: Opaque plate with fixed layout so provenance stays visible in any screenshot.
object_craft.articulation: Updates only when a different dataset is loaded.

physical_contract.scope: Dataset playback and presentation; no hydrological computation.
checks: Every frame shows its model time and provenance.
Playback stops at the end of the dataset horizon.

records.summary: Compare pressure probes at the same depth in differently shaped stationary containers.
records.objective: Show two differently shaped liquid vessels with movable depth probes and pressure arrows derived from p=p0+rho*g*h.
intent_signals: Show two differently shaped liquid vessels with movable depth probes and pressure arrows derived from p=p0+rho*g*h.
Compare pressure probes at the same depth in differently shaped stationary containers.
example_prompts: Show two differently shaped liquid vessels with movable depth probes and pressure arrows derived from p=p0+rho*g*h.
Create an explorable 3D explanation of hydrostatic pressure with depth and pressure rulers.
negative_signals: No stratification, compressible gas, dynamic pressure or container structural analysis.
not_for: No stratification, compressible gas, dynamic pressure or container structural analysis.

entities.name: Vessel cutaways
entities.guidance: Build a narrow cylinder and broad stepped vessel with clear inner walls and horizontal surfaces; keep the liquid explicitly at rest.

entities.name: Pressure probes
entities.guidance: Place small probe disks at selected equal depths and draw normal pressure arrows using a shared pressure-to-length scale.

entities.name: Depth and pressure rulers
entities.guidance: Show h from the free surface, rho, g and separate gauge/absolute readouts; units are meters, kg/m^3 and pascals.

state_contract.model: Static liquid with constant density rho>0, uniform g>0, common absolute surface pressure p0>=0 and depth h>=0 below each free surface. Gauge pressure rho*g*h; absolute pressure adds p0.
state_contract.authority: Density, gravity, free-surface height and probe depth own all pressures. Container shape affects the display geometry, not this point-pressure relation.
actions: Drag probes vertically within the liquid.
Link probes to equal depth across vessels.

invariants: Equal depths with the same liquid and surface pressure give equal pressure regardless of vessel width.
Gauge pressure is zero at the free surface.
Pressure arrows act normal to the local probe face; their lengths do not represent liquid speed.
motion_guidance: Probe dragging is an inspection action; no sloshing or flow is generated by moving a diagram probe.
If surface height changes, recompute depth from the new surface before updating pressure.
known_limits: No stratification, compressible gas, dynamic pressure or container structural analysis.
This point-pressure model does not by itself compute total force on a curved wall.
Curated recipe only; no runtime scene or rendered behavior has been verified for this record.

claims.statement: Pressure in a stationary constant-density liquid increases by rho*g*h below its free surface under uniform gravity.
claims.scope: Static liquid with the same imposed surface pressure and density.

object_craft.structure: Build a narrow cylinder and broad stepped vessel with clear inner walls and horizontal surfaces; keep the liquid explicitly at rest.
object_craft.material: Translucent liquid and matte vessel cutaway edges; pressure arrows and depth rulers use opaque marks independent of refraction.

physical_contract.scope: Static analytic pressure field; no flow simulation.
colliders: No rigid-body colliders; any boundary is part of the declared mathematical model.
driving: Uniform gravity and liquid depth determine pressure.
contact: No collision or impact response is supplied by this field model.
physical_contract.timestep: Evaluate the declared analytic state at paused or running model time; rendering never advances a second model.

quality_brief.draw_call_note: Background and repeated objects stay one InstancedMesh at T1 and are never wrapped in a LOD. Eval run 3 measured 4,773 draw calls at 5 fps with every object built as a separate mesh - that measurement is the concrete reason this note exists. An instanced field is one draw call whatever the count; a LOD per repeat adds a per-frame update and removes no draws.
quality_brief.note: Recommendations, not limits. Raise or lower any of them and say so in design-system.md. Every blueprint also has a T0 proxy (kits/kit-lod.js blockout) for the layout pass, whatever tier it finally renders at.
